briefings.title: CVE-2026-104935: Ivanti Connect Secure actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-96951: Microsoft Windows actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

briefings.title: CVE-2015-5477: ISC BIND actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-106173 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.8)
briefings.excerpt: A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-37107 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.8)
briefings.excerpt: An issue in HTMLy v.3.1.1 allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges via the get_feed function in the admin.php component

briefings.title: CVE-2026-100202 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.8)
briefings.excerpt: Use after free in Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
